act6/camp/manage_equip.title: Arm Against the Void
act6/camp/manage_equip.body: The light **trembles**; every buckle seems to **negotiate** with shadow. You reorganize what you still call **yours**: **weapon**, **armor**, **relics** — small promises that the next step will not be the last.

choices.text: Return to the fire

act6/camp/use_consumable.title: Potions at hand
act6/camp/use_consumable.body: In the false light of the fire, the flasks look like small **mirrors**. You choose which lie to drink first — life, mana, or calm.

choices.text: Drink Red Potion (self)
Give Red Potion to companion
Drink Blue Tonic (mana)
Drink Mead (stress)
Return to camp

act6/camp/void_camp.title: Fire of Mirrored Ash
act6/camp/void_camp.body:
There is no **firewood** — only **remains** of those who already burned themselves. The fire **imitates** warmth; your body accepts the lie because it **needs** a place to pretend there is still **tomorrow**.

*Even here, the number follows: **day {{day}}** — mirrored in ash.*

choices.text: Feed the flame with memory (−1 supply)
choices.lockedHint: You need at least 1 supply to feed the flame.

choices.text: Use a consumable
Exchange a few words with the group
Watch the gray swallow another day
choices.preview: The narrative day advances; you recover no strength.

choices.text: Manage equipment by the unstable light
Return to the fractured nave

act6/camp/void_companion_chat.title: Word by the False Flame
act6/camp/void_companion_chat.body:
{{companionLine}}

If you are alone, silence doubles the voice you already carry inside. Here, even the echo seems tired of repeating lies.

choices.text: Listen to Mira — voice against the echo
Listen to Tomás — shield against the void
Stand between the two — three breaths, one flame
Mira: "Fallen knight or not — here the ground does not distinguish oath"
Mira: "Honest darkness, you said once. The void charges interest"
Mira: "Penitence is weight; do not drop it now or you grow too light"
Mira: "Marksman without a banner — here even the shadow wants to know whose you are"
Tomás: "The shield reminds me of your steel — both lie that they hold everything"
Tomás: "If the void reads your journal, what remains unwritten?"
Tomás: "Faith in a place without echo — courage or habit?"
Tomás: "Arrow in the dark — do you trust the eye or the silence before the shot?"
Return to the fire

act6/camp/void_duo_fireside.title: Three Voices in the Fractured Nave
act6/camp/void_duo_fireside.body:
**Mira** and **Tomás** measure each other at the fire; no one wants to die **alone** here. You, {{leadName}}, stand in the middle — **witness**, not judge.

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Choose neither — only continue

act6/camp/void_mira_fireside.title: Ash — Confidences with Mira
act6/camp/void_mira_fireside.body:
> *"Here echo **lies** less than people. That is not comfort — it is **warning**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if she still recognizes her own shadow
Speak of the end as a door, not a pit
Return to the false flame circle

act6/camp/void_mira_topic_end.title: Door or Pit
act6/camp/void_mira_topic_end.body:
> *"Door closes; well **swallows**. I prefer door — I know alleys."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Return to the unstable light
diaryTexts: Mira spoke of the end as a crack — not victory. I keep this as one keeps a match: little, but enough to see the next step.

act6/camp/void_mira_topic_mirror.title: Shadow and Mirror
act6/camp/void_mira_topic_mirror.body:
> *"Shadows here have **teeth**. If you see me hesitate, do not call pity — call **time**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Leave this reflection — return to the group

act6/camp/void_tomas_fireside.title: Ash — Word with Tomás
act6/camp/void_tomas_fireside.body:
> *"This is not a field — it is **trial**. And trial asks no applause; it asks **steps**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Ask if his faith sounds different here
Speak of duty when the ground promises no firmness
Return to the false flame circle

act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_duty.title: Duty Without Ground
act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_duty.body:
> *"Duty needs no ground — it needs **someone** not to lie to. If we fall, we fall **together**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Return to the group

act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_faith.title: Faith in the Void
act6/camp/void_tomas_topic_faith.body:
> *"Faith does not change sound — it changes **echo**. If God falls silent, I still raise the **shield**."*

{{companionLine}}

choices.text: Leave the prayer unfinished — and return

act6/dimensional_smith/entry.title: Corridor of the Blind Anvil
act6/dimensional_smith/entry.body:
A fissure cuts the nave wall.

Inside: **iron, pause, iron**. No ember. No bellows.

choices.text: Enter through the wall's cut and follow the sound
Return to the columns before being noticed

onEnterDiaryTexts: I heard hammer where there was no forge; the void decided to fuse something in me.

act6/dimensional_smith/forge.title: Dimensional Workshop
act6/dimensional_smith/forge.body:
The workshop ceiling breathes crooked — no visible fire. The smith does not smile; only measures your breath between strikes.

*"**Iron** lives. **Gold** silences. Want a miracle? Bring scrap from an encounter."*

choices.text: Temper Iron Dagger (10 gold)
Reforge Rusty Sword (12 gold)
Forge Dimensional Ward Plate (Fracture Iron + Void Slag)
choices.lockedHint: Requires 1 Fracture Iron and 1 Void Slag.
diaryTexts: The dimensional ward plate left the forge as if it remembered my name.

choices.text: Leave the workshop

act6/dimensional_smith/unlock.title: The Forge Between Hinges
act6/dimensional_smith/unlock.body:
The smith seems more noise than man.

He strikes invisible metal and stops without looking at you.

"**Paid. Trade. Gone.**"

"If you return, bring metal that has seen the void."

choices.text: Speak. Accept the workshop's mark.
diaryTexts: The smith opened the workshop with three words and a crooked look.

choices.text: Retreat to the fractured nave

act6/encounters/memory_trial_bleed.title: Hemorrhage of Echoes
act6/encounters/memory_trial_bleed.body:
You fall without axis into the pit. Old faces grab your wrists as if you owed all of them.

When you breathe again, the Chorus is already before you.

choices.text: Fight while memories tear you

onEnterDiaryTexts: Memories came in a pack and none asked permission.

act6/encounters/memory_trial_safe.title: Ballast of Name
act6/encounters/memory_trial_safe.body: You choose a name to anchor yourself to the present. It works for a moment, and a moment is enough to face the abyss with a straight spine.

choices.text: Dive with the echo under control

onEnterDiaryTexts: I repeat my name as one drives a stake into a shoreless sea.

act6/encounters/mirror_boss_blades.title: The Other Name — Steel
act6/encounters/mirror_boss_blades.body: [DRAFT] The **mirror** **closes** **negotiation**. What remains is **shadow** with **teeth** — and **you** with **blade**.

choices.text: Fight my sovereign reflection

act6/encounters/mirror_boss_intro.title: The Other Name
act6/encounters/mirror_boss_intro.body:
From the mirror steps someone with your face and your posture, but without hesitation. He smiles as one who already won every argument with his own conscience.

> *"I am you without fear. You are me without courage."*

If he wins, you will keep living. You just will not keep **being**.

choices.text: Take words from the reflection before steel (draft)
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation; failure leads to physical combat.

choices.text: Fight my sovereign reflection

act6/encounters/mirror_boss_resolve.title: Stitching of Shadow
act6/encounters/mirror_boss_resolve.body:
The reflection unravels into black threads that do not attack you. They seek shelter in your body's outline, like a cloak made of everything you denied.

There is no clean triumph. Only a lucid pact: walk with darkness on a short leash.

choices.text: Accept the fissure and move on

onEnterDiaryTexts: I did not destroy my shadow. I gave it a name and a limit.

act6/encounters/reality_trial_focus.title: Coherent Fissure
act6/encounters/reality_trial_focus.body:
You hold a single version of the room for a few seconds. Enough to distinguish stone from reflection and fear from warning.

The Herald smiles without a mouth.

choices.text: Face the Herald with a fixed mind

onEnterDiaryTexts: I held the world by a thread of thought. I discovered thought also cuts.

act6/encounters/reality_trial_shatter.title: Fissure Without Axis
act6/encounters/reality_trial_shatter.body:
Walls swap places and your own body seems to arrive late to every gesture. Stepping on the floor becomes an act of faith.

The Herald does not advance. He waits for your fall to call it proof.

choices.text: Fight even with faith failing

onEnterDiaryTexts: When the real split, shadow entered first.

act6/encounters/void_encounter_corruptio.title: Rust That Dances
act6/encounters/void_encounter_corruptio.body:
The **corruption** you carry is no secret to the stone — it **vibrates**, calls **shards** and a **preacher** who already had your name written on his tongue.

This is not divine punishment. It is **ecology** of the void: where there is stain, there is **predator**.

choices.text: Contain the surge — stain preacher and shard drawn to the wound

act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo.title: Whispers Without Audience
act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo.body:
The air **thickens** with voices that have no owner — they remind you of **wrong** names and **right** dates, and laugh when you correct them.

This is not music. It is **memory** on strike.

choices.text: Endure the host until one mouth at a time falls silent

act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo_frag.title: Memory with Teeth
act6/encounters/void_encounter_echo_frag.body: The **host** repeats what you did not say; the **shard** completes what you **fled** saying. Between the two, a **new** story is born — worse than yours, because it is **coherent**.

choices.text: Cut the host and tear out the shard that feeds it

act6/encounters/void_encounter_fragment_.title: Decision That Remained
act6/encounters/void_encounter_fragment_.body:
From the floor **rises** a silhouette with no stable face — it did not come from outside; it **escaped** you years ago and learned to **walk** alone.

It asks no forgiveness. It asks **continuity**.

choices.text: Face the wandering shard between the columns

act6/encounters/void_encounter_pair_frag.title: Siblings of Renunciation
act6/encounters/void_encounter_pair_frag.body: Two shadows **argue** in whisper — not with you, **between themselves** — about which lie serves you best. When they see you, the debate **ends**: first you are eaten, then the rest.

choices.text: Separate the two shards before they fuse

act6/encounters/void_encounter_penitent.title: Penitence Without Confessor
act6/encounters/void_encounter_penitent.body:
Metal **groans** where there should be no smith — only **will** tempered in cold. The armor does not protect the body; it **silences** hesitation.

Every step of his is a **sentence** read in a low voice.

choices.text: Measure blades with the penitent of links

act6/encounters/void_encounter_shadow_ra.title: Regent Without Throne
act6/encounters/void_encounter_shadow_ra.body:
For a **thread** of a second, the air **stays** with you — it does not mirror; it **reigns** over shards. What moves asks no name: it **imposes** silence where you still **negotiated** with doubt.

This is not narrative ambush. It is **consequence** asking for place.

choices.text: Face the regent of broken glass head-on

act6/encounters/void_encounter_triple_fr.title: Swarm of Falls
act6/encounters/void_encounter_triple_fr.body:
Three shadows **rose** from the same fault — they are not copies; they are **versions** that gained body on different days. Together, they form an **argument** that does not fit in one head.

The nave **tilts** as if agreeing.

choices.text: Hold against the shard swarm

act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil.title: Scribe Between Dead Mirrors
act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil.body:
A **tall** figure crosses the gloom as one **writes** in the air — there is no blood, there is **certainty** dripping from the veil's corners; **ink** where there should be skin.

The voice does not ask if you are ready. It treats **readiness** as a child's defect.

choices.text: Answer the scribe before he stitches sky to your throat

act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil_frag.title: Veil and Shard
act6/encounters/void_encounter_veil_frag.body:
The **Scribe** traces; the **shard** obeys — not as servant, as living **footnote** to your fear.

Together, they close a circle that asks no permission to **exist**.

choices.text: Break the pair before the fragment becomes dogma

act6/encounters/will_trial.title: Trial of Will
act6/encounters/will_trial.body:
Atop the altar, a crown of **obsidian** thorns turns slowly. A faceless penitent holds a blade without metal:

> *"Do you want **power** to protect, or to never tremble again?"*

To choose is to lose a version of yourself forever.

choices.text: Submit impulse to the altar's chance
Force direct confrontation against the penitent
choices.preview: Immediate steel — or hesitate and let the altar decide.

act6/encounters/will_trial_duel.title: Duel of the Empty Crown
act6/encounters/will_trial_duel.body: The altar chooses silence. Only the Penitent advances, as if each step were a word that cannot be unsaid.

choices.text: Sustain the duel and pay the price

act6/encounters/will_trial_horde.title: Crown of Hunger
act6/encounters/will_trial_horde.body: The crown splits into several fragments and each fragment wears your face. It is no longer duel: it is tribunal of shadows.

choices.text: Break the circle of hungry echoes

onEnterDiaryTexts: Will without bridle called versions of me that only know conquest.

act6/epilogue.title: Epilogue of the Broken Mirror
act6/epilogue.body:
You carry the fractured nave in your eyes — **shard** of mirror that lied on the first step, now **cut** in the palm. To those who look quickly, the world above is the same.

For you, streets become hypotheses; the **green pulse** did not change tone — you changed how you **count** it. One step, not from purity: from **choice**.

choices.text: Lift your eyes — the sky no longer apologizes
Close the journal for now

act6/fractured_merchant.title: Stall of the Last Price
act6/fractured_merchant.body:
On cloth that **reflects** nothing, flasks line up like **teeth** in a closed mouth. Who sells shows no **hands** — only **prices** that rise when you hesitate, because here the **last** buyer already paid with what they did not have.

> **Limited** stock. The void **charges** interest in gold — and in **memories** you would rather have left behind.

choices.text: Buy nave map (−4 gold)
Buy Red Potion (8 gold) (×2)
Buy Red Potion (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Blue Tonic (7 gold) (×1)
Buy Mead (6 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×2)
Buy Supply (5 gold) (×1)
Buy Supply (10 gold) (×1)
choices.lockedHint: Requires 10 gold, level 32+, and prior stock already bought.

choices.text: Vigil field kit (−7 gold)
choices.preview: Supply · Vigil seal (once at this stall)

choices.text: Step away from the stall

act6/hub_fractured_nave.title: Fractured Nave
act6/hub_fractured_nave.body:
Three corridors lie about what it means to live; the **Void** opens **one at a time** — **sentence**, not map.

In the ceiling, cracks **constellate** impossible faces of yours. Between columns, fire and ownerless **stall** pretend business with those already clients of the void.

choices.text: Patrol the fractured nave (explore map)
choices.preview: Move between columns and ruins; stress rises and the void may answer.

choices.text: Follow the corridor of broken mirrors (Trial of Reality)
choices.preview: First cord: reality; permanent mark according to outcome.
choices.lockedHint: You need level 26 for the first cord; once the trial is complete, the corridor no longer opens here.

choices.text: Descend to the bottomless memory pit (Trial of Memory)
choices.preview: Only after the real: memory; echo leaves a mark.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 26+ and completing the Trial of Reality first.

choices.text: Climb to the altar of bare will (Trial of Will)
choices.preview: Last trial before the mirror; will measured or split.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 26+ and completing the Trial of Memory first.

choices.text: Cross the Inner Mirror Gate
choices.preview: Three trials done; the final mirror opens.
choices.lockedHint: Three trials, map goal, and level 31 — the mirror does not open early.

choices.text: Light the fire of mirrored ash (camp)
choices.preview: A breath of supply and broken silence.

choices.text: Trade with the forgotten stall merchant
choices.preview: Remedies and prices in gold or promise.

choices.text: Seek the Dimensional Smith
choices.preview: Few words, much metal, and exact charge.

choices.text: Listen to the whisper beneath the columns (corruption route)
choices.preview: Pact in the void; requires high corruption and level.
choices.lockedHint: Requires level 31+, corruption 4+, and the Trial of Reality completed.

act6/litany_after_memory.title: Litany of Fleeing Names
act6/litany_after_memory.body:
The chorus **tunes** to a silence that is not peace — it is **waiting**. Memory is not archive here; it is rope. You feel it stretch toward the third trial, where there are no witnesses, only **order** or **hunger**.

---

choices.text: Climb without looking back — the pit has eaten enough

act6/litany_after_reality.title: Litany of Cut Reality
act6/litany_after_reality.body:
The columns **repeat** your step one tone below your ear — not echo: **debt**. The real already bit you; what comes next does not ask if you still like your name, only if you hold it on your tongue.

---

choices.text: Accept that the next throat only speaks when this one falls silent

act6/litany_after_will.title: Litany of the Empty Crown
act6/litany_after_will.body:
The circle of dust around your feet **closes** like contract. Three trials, three **bites** in the same body: the Void does not distribute victory — it distributes **consistency**. If you still breathe whole, the nave reminds you that whole is only another form of **incomplete** with pride.

---

choices.text: Return to the esplanade — the final mirror demands the three marks

act6/memory_after.title: Ballast of Memory
act6/memory_after.body:
The chorus dissolves into drops of dark ink that rise instead of fall. Each drop brings a face you loved and did not save.

The pit falls silent when you speak your own name with no title.

choices.text: Climb back to the fractured nave

onEnterDiaryTexts: My memories are not archive. They are battlefield.

act6/memory_trial.title: Trial of Memory
act6/memory_trial.body:
In the well, you see scenes of your life in layers — when you try to touch one memory, another wakes beneath and asks who wrote the first.

> *"To **remember** is to choose what to kill."*

choices.text: Hold a name on your tongue before diving
choices.preview: Without anchor in time, the pit drinks without asking.

choices.text: Fall into the pit without ties

act6/mirror_gate.title: Inner Mirror Gate
act6/mirror_gate.body:
The nave's three marks shine at once and the floor opens in a perfect arch. On the other side, a room without doors.

At the center, a vertical mirror of water. It does not reflect your body: it reflects your **intent**.

choices.text: Enter and face who inhabits me

onEnterDiaryTexts: I passed the three questions and none absolved me.

act6/nave_summons.title: Chorus Before the Queue
act6/nave_summons.body:
The columns **order themselves** without moving: you understand you will not choose *everything at once* — you will **cross** one at a time, and each leaves **scar** before letting the next pass.

A faceless chorus rehearses your name in three tones. The first already **asks** entry.

choices.text: Climb to the esplanade where only one trial breathes at a time

onEnterDiaryTexts: The Void does not open a menu — it opens a queue. Three throats, one at a time, as if time here were rope and not clock.

act6/opening_void_threshold.title: Void Threshold
act6/opening_void_threshold.body:
The ice **opens** beneath the Heights: **nave** without altar, hung between stone and night — cathedral for a question.

Every echo returns **late**, another person with your name; the air smells of **truth before it has a name**. On the broken columns: *if the world is dream, who wakes when you fall?*

choices.text: Enter the fractured nave and hear what remains of the world

onEnterDiaryTexts: At the bottom of the ice was a door without hinge. I entered and the world answered with my voice, but without my mercy.

act6/reality_after.title: Scar of the Real
act6/reality_after.body:
The herald's mask cracks in perfect lines, like glass that already knew where to fall. Behind it there is no flesh, only a void with your breath.

You gather a fragment of black mirror. It does not reflect light; it reflects **decision** — not new promise: the **remainder** of the first descent, when you already knew the reflection was not heroism.

choices.text: Let the chorus answer and return to the esplanade

onEnterDiaryTexts: Truth did not free me. It only took my right to lie to myself.

act6/reality_trial.title: Trial of Reality
act6/reality_trial.body:
The mirrors show **you** with easier choices — you never entered the Silent Dungeon, or you were loved by all and forgotten by all.

The metallic-veiled herald inclines: *real is what **insists***; the floor liquefies for an instant — you only stay standing if you choose which pain you call truth.

choices.text: Try to fix a single world with the mind
choices.preview: Without fixing in time, the veil splits.

choices.text: Close your eyes and accept collapse

act6/void_secret_claim.title: Mark of the Hollow Blade
act6/void_secret_claim.body:
The mirror touches your chest from within. A dark line remains on the sternum, hot like freshly forged metal.

When you close your hand, the mark answers.

choices.text: Return to the fractured nave with the mark active

onEnterDiaryTexts: I learned a new creed: bleed to wound better.

act6/void_secret_entry.title: Vein of the Abyss
act6/void_secret_entry.body: The columns part without moving. Between them rises a corridor of wet stone, made of angles the eye refuses.

choices.text: Follow the corridor that does not exist on the map
Listen for metal in the vein — the trail that does not fade
choices.preview: Verbal confrontation with Kael (draft); failure leads to steel.

choices.text: Retreat before the void recognizes you

onEnterDiaryTexts: Corruption opened a door lucidity did not see.

act6/void_secret_pact.title: Liturgy of the Fissure
act6/void_secret_pact.body:
An opaque mirror rises from the floor and writes your name with your own shadow. The offer is simple: convert pain into strength, turn after turn.

There is no witness, only cost.

choices.text: Accept the pact and carve the seal into the body

act6/will_after.title: Oath Without Witnesses
act6/will_after.body:
The penitent falls to his knees, but does not bleed. Instead, he scatters black dust that writes a circle around your feet.

Inside it, you feel a new certainty: you are not pure, but you are still yours.

choices.text: Descend to the fractured nave

onEnterDiaryTexts: Will is not strength to defeat everyone. It is discipline not to obey the worst in me. The amulet of the trials pulses — a ward against heat you have not yet seen.
